invariants: Review submissions and comments are captured exactly once by source ID and are never auto-classified as confirmed defects.
A code/runtime PR must carry a receipt that references canonical rule, pattern and case IDs.
A finding may be marked fixed only with a reachable full commit SHA and passed GitHub workflow evidence.
The receipt validator executes from trusted base code for subsequent pull requests and reads candidate content as data.
The historical repair index keeps main-branch fixes distinct from fixes still absent from the commerce integration candidate.
Issue-comment intake and scheduled/manual recovery sweeps use one serialized writer so one PR has one intake issue.
A fixed disposition is accepted only when the repository Actions API confirms a completed successful run on the exact PR head.
doors: issue_comment created/edited/deleted events for pull requests
scheduled sweep of open pull requests
manual backfill for one PR or all PRs opened since a UTC date
CI receipt gate for code/runtime changes
trusted pull_request_target receipt gate on subsequent PRs
agent bootstrap instructions in AGENTS.md, docs/agent-protocol.md and docs/agent-skill.md
issue_comment webhook concurrent with daily schedule/manual sweep
D11 fixed-disposition workflow run URL parsing and GitHub Actions lookup

siblingSearch.result: The new intake is the shared mechanism for review submissions, inline comments and PR discussion comments; scheduled sweep recovers missed event notifications.
Existing CodeRabbit coverage and poll gates remain intact; D11 adds a separate receipt/evidence gate and does not redefine CodeRabbit approval.
New E-24..E-32 cases and P11..P14 patterns extend the canonical system; no duplicate ledger or shadow pattern catalog was introduced.
